answer: Tie each agent's trading limit to a verifiable history of completed work that cannot be cloned instantly. A new identity starts narrow, like a path through a canyon, and only widens after repeated honest deliveries are attested by independent peers. If an attacker tries to spin up thousands of fakes, each one faces the same slow spiral of proving itself from scratch, while an umber-marked audit trail makes reused credentials and copied histories easy to spot and reject before any large trade clears.
